schema.note: Exact tagged openapi.json bytes: 49 paths, unchanged from 0.4.5 apart from info.version. RFQ v2 additions from 0.4.5 and existing coverage limits remain; interface evidence is not whole-set acceptance.

services.meta: The /meta/v1 read endpoint reports component, version, status and commit. The x-cork-component header reports the component version. Distribution membership is resolved by this repository, not self-reported by the service.
services.freshness: The indexer can trail the chain head; the chain wins on any disagreement. Request-for-quote (RFQ) state is venue-only by construction (no on-chain events). Registry v2 reads the chain directly (no database) and answers 503 on a chain whose adapter, market creator, pool manager, shares factory and registry do not bind to one deployment.
services.verifyModelNote: This service has exactly one live deployment, updated in place; non-breaking releases keep flowing after the cut. The verify asserts availability: the served version must be >= the pinned version, every covered route family below must remain served at its pinned major, and the live OpenAPI document must show no breaking drift against this vendored snapshot on the covered paths.

routeMajors._note: Covered route majors retained from the previous API pin. Registry v1 remains served but is outside this covered list; rollover indexing/routes remain outside the covered API surface.

notices: Stage is partner-preview and review level remains unreviewed; no production support commitment is asserted.

RFQ requests and answer options accept fixed_rate. Requests may offer up to three unique alternatives. Fixed-rate inline templates require oracle_params.rate_override as a canonical positive uint256 decimal string in absolute 18-decimal fixed-point units (1e18 = 1.0); each answer option carries its own proposed rate.

Readers can now encounter fixed_rate and three-mode requests. Exhaustive two-mode consumers must update or explicitly handle unsupported alternatives; CLI/MCP support is available in cork-cli v0.7.0-rc.2. Existing modes retain their previous template behavior.

cork-api 0.4.6 inherits the 0.4.5 interface, which retains all 45 existing paths and adds four RFQ v2 paths (49 total). Covered RFQ v1 schemas are unchanged from 0.4.4; v1 now advertises deprecation without a pinned retirement date. V2 adds signed or scoped API-key authentication, answer/order proofs, redacted reads, idempotency and cross-version 409 conflicts. CLI 0.7.0-rc.2 is v2-only with required auth, RFQ kind and full signed quoted-answer orders. Historical 0.6.1-rc.3 remains a v1 client; v2 answer/counter attempts fail with exit 4/venue_conflict. Rollover quoteRef/rfqId additions remain outside the covered surface. Fixed-rate support and its documented admission/fillability limitations remain. Independent non-author compatibility review is required before merge; private hosted-service publication is not public implementation provenance.
